subject: Decision Making
title: Social Media Echo Chambers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Social Media Echo Chambers.

hook.text: Algorithms show you content you already agree with. Your feed becomes a mirror, not a window.

buildup.text: In an echo chamber, extreme views seem normal because everyone around you shares them. Moderate voices disappear.

discovery.text: Echo chambers violate every condition for crowd wisdom: no diversity, no independence, centralized algorithms.

twist.text: Exposing people to opposing views can backfire. They often dig in deeper.

climax.text: Social Media Echo Chambers matters because structure beats guesswork when stakes are high.

punchline.text: Same opinions, louder and louder. Echo chambers are crowd wisdom in reverse.

quiz.question: Why do echo chambers destroy crowd wisdom?
options: They eliminate diversity and independence, violating all conditions for collective accuracy
